meta.title: اختبار الفصل الأول في اللغة الإنجليزية (النموذج 2)
topics: the present simple vs the present continuous

paper:
My name is Zakaria. I'm fifteen and I'm from Tizi Ouzou. I am creative and patient. I love drawing and I enjoy playing chess with my grandfather. I don't like watching TV because I find it boring. My favourite food is couscous with vegetables. Right now, I am preparing a drawing for a school competition. I hope I will win the first prize!

Part One (14 points)

A. Reading comprehension (7 points)

1. True or false? a) Zakaria is impatient. b) He enjoys playing chess. c) He likes watching TV.

2. Answer: a) What is his favourite food? b) What is he doing now?

3. Find in the text a word closest in meaning to: like = …

B. Mastery of language (7 points)

1. Put the verbs in the correct form: Zakaria loves (draw) … . — Look! He (play) … chess now. — He usually (visit) … his grandfather on Fridays.

2. Write the opposites: patient ≠ … ; creative ≠ …

3. Circle the silent letter: know – write – hour

Part Two (6 points)

Written expression

Write an email to a new pen friend (70–90 words) to introduce yourself: your personality, your hobbies, what you like and dislike doing.
